```go
func Serve(ctx context.Context, l net.Listener, s *store.Store) error {
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    var mu sync.Mutex
    var conns []net.Conn
    ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
    defer cancel()
    // accept loop
    go func() {
        for {
            c, err := l.Accept()
            if err != nil { return }
            mu.Lock()
            conns = append(conns, c)
            mu.Unlock()
            wg.Add(1)
            go func() { defer wg.Done(); handle(ctx, c, s); remove from conns; }()
        }
    }()
    <-ctx.Done()
    l.Close()
    mu.Lock(); for _, c := range conns { c.Close() } ; conns = nil; mu.Unlock()
    wg.Wait()
    return nil
}
```
